choices.label: Let the Children Explain Their Game

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The knots are turns in a make-believe journey; the adults finally understand the rules.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The doll is a message of welcome for a child who has been sitting alone.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child), a shy child, reveals that each knot represents someone who helped them.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (adult) keeps interrupting, and the children politely insist on finishing their explanation.
